substrate_status.summary: Prior work reproduced G27 pressure evidence, suppressed singleton isometry row 32, selected non-singleton row 685, retained Moser-basis breaker suppression, and identified missing exact unit-attachment evidence.

round_counts_only_if: A concrete mathematical hypothesis is stated before implementation.
The round runs or implements the minimum exact check needed to test that hypothesis.
The result is retained as candidate evidence, suppression evidence, or falsification evidence.
The outcome decides whether the hypothesis is funded, revised, or retired.
The next round is derived from the outcome, not pre-planned.
does_not_count_as_round: Infrastructure that only makes future tests possible.
Shape-only candidate syntax without exact mathematical replay.
Solver output without independent in-crate replay.
Moser-lattice or Moser-ring breakers counted as escape evidence.
Prose notes without retained artifact evidence.
authority_rules: No theorem, proof, checker, or Query invariant authority is minted by these rounds.
A candidate can become mutation-eligible only after exact unit-distance attachment replay.
A slack-response round can run only after a retained mutated graph exists.
